verdict.rationale: A government tax and workforce portal could plausibly offer programmatic credentials, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only a shared user ID and password for UTR/UTS and a desktop QuickFile tool. No API keys, scoped tokens, or least-privilege credential issuance are documented, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
